critical_code_review_comments: All 6 new features implemented correctly and working
SL/TP auto-close logic in GET /api/trading/positions checks price levels and closes trades automatically
Challenges auto-check after closing trades via _check_challenges() function
Stats calculates profile based on avg_lot and win_rate (Agresivo/Conservador/Estrategico/Moderado)
Risk simulator returns 8 scenarios for different price movements (-5%, -2%, -1%, -0.5%, +0.5%, +1%, +2%, +5%)
Learning modules have content with markdown formatting
Replay uses canvas-rendered mini candlestick chart (ReplayMiniChart component)
seed_data_creation: Test trades created during testing, account reset available via /api/trading/reset
context_for_next_testing_agent: 6 new features added to Trading Demo: 1) SL/TP on orders with auto-close, 2) Replay mode with canvas chart, 3) 8 trading challenges with XP/badges, 4) Stats/profile endpoint, 5) Risk simulator, 6) Learning center with 5 modules. All backend endpoints tested via pytest. Frontend UI verified via Playwright. Trading prices are MOCKED (simulated).
